Charge Tanks Tools

Interactive battery tools for engineers

Explore voltage limits, OCV behavior, lithium inventory, and aging with an interactive tool suite built around the two-tank model.

Launch Tool SuiteRead the Articles

What the suite helps you inspect

The goal is not a black-box calculator. Each tool is built to make the physical trade-offs visible and easy to reason about.

Voltage and OCV intuition

See how electrode behavior, fill levels, and voltage windows fit together without losing the physical picture.

Capacity balance and lithium inventory

Explore how anode and cathode sizing interact with available lithium and why the limiting reservoir matters.

Aging and design trade-offs

Compare loss modes and inspect how the same amount of degradation can produce very different outcomes.

Use the tools with the blog, not instead of it

The articles explain the model and the assumptions behind it. The tools let you test those ideas against parameter changes.

  1. Start with an article to understand the physical picture.
  2. Open the tool suite and reproduce the same effect interactively.
  3. Return to the blog when you want the design reasoning in more detail.
